The name Brindita carries the meaning “Lord Krishna's beloved” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Brindita usually hope their child will grow to embody lord krishna's beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
